image-generation.prompt-elaborate:
A 45-year-old Italian woman (use Elena Higgsfield reference), lived-in face, warm brown hair natural. Standing in a clean modern Italian kitchen at late morning natural light. She wears a fitted black athletic short-sleeve top (suggesting active lifestyle).
Hands gestured open palms-up at chest level in a "but why" gesture - hands soft natural, NOT theatrical. Stance grounded.
Expression: Italian "lo sguardo del paradosso" - both eyebrows slightly raised 2mm, mouth slight asymmetric smirk left corner up 4mm, eyes direct camera with "I know it doesn't make sense" empathy. Slight head tilt right 4°.
Camera: iPhone 15 Pro vertical equivalent, eye level, distance 100cm.
Light: single soft window light camera-left at 45°, 5000K neutral, subtle natural fill.
Aesthetic: contemporary Italian fitness coach Instagram 2026, NOT cinematic.
Body: real Italian woman 45, average proportions with subtle definition (consistent with someone who works out moderately).
Color grading: neutral white balance + 3% warmth.
Composition: subject center frame chest up, hands gesture visible mid-frame, plenty of clean negative space top/bottom for brand overlay.
image-generation.negative-prompt: cinematic editorial, golden hour, model thin, instagram filter, beauty retouch, makeup heavy, fitness influencer flexing pose
